claim: AWS first announced November 30, 2025 as the end-of-life date for Performance Insights; the CloudWatch guide now says the end-of-life date for Performance Insights was July 31, 2026, and that AWS has migrated Performance Insights users to Database Insights.
question: What happened to Performance Insights, and what replaced it for Aurora monitoring?

values.display: migrated Performance Insights users to Database Insights

qualifiers.condition: the first announcement (Aurora document history, May 30, 2025) gave November 30, 2025

evidence.quote: AWS announced that the end-of-life date for Performance Insights was July 31, 2026, and has migrated Performance Insights users to Database Insights.

| [End-of-life information for Performance Insights](#WhatsNew) | AWS has announced the end-of-life date for Performance Insights: November 30, 2025. After this date, Amazon RDS will no longer support the Performance Insights console experience, flexible retention periods, and their associated pricing. We recommend upgrading your DB clusters to Database Insights before this date. For more information, see [Monitoring DB load with Performance Insights on Amazon Aurora](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/USER_PerfInsights.html). | May 30, 2025 |

note: Adjudicated 2026-10-13: the currency vote found the moved date (July 31, 2026) on the CloudWatch Database Insights page. Monitoring answers: CloudWatch Database Insights.
